ops.title: v10.3.0 is claimed by the helper release — renumber comment-budget work
ops.body: Commit 045650d6 stamped the committed Unreleased section (the Captain Hook.app helper work) as 10.3.0 and renamed the helper cask token to captain-hook; the v10.3.0 tag cuts the first helper release (cask-publish proof). The in-flight verbose-comment-budget + doc-classification work had claimed 10.3.0 in an uncommitted CHANGELOG hunk; that hunk's header was converted to '## [Unreleased]' in the shared working copy (entries untouched, still uncommitted). When that work ships, take 10.4.0 (it removes DOC_PREFIXES/GO_DOC_SIBLINGS exports — arguably minor per the repo's convention) and move the Unreleased section above 10.3.0 if the editor placed it below.
